checks.name: A new phone opens a ready balloon with a usable hold button and no introduction
A real near-limit press and release earns one score and retries with the next press
Holding through the limit pops in under ten seconds and releases cannot award again
Space works as one hold, repeated keydowns do not restart, and outside inputs stay editable
Keyboard repeat and release after a pop cannot scroll or restart, and moving to a form cancels
Native touch release scores once and a second finger cannot restart the active balloon
Touch cancellation aborts without inventing a score or completed round
Blur and a reset dialog cancel held input safely, with no reward on a late release
Five languages and reload preserve earned local results and leave no placeholders
Canvas and single hold control fit 320px and stay readable after a result

Canvas and single hold control fit 1365px and stay readable after a result

A rejected reset write at asobi:leaderboard restores all previous values
